sources.title: Listed building
sources.facts: 382,254 rows; 2 providers; collector and new data 2026-07-24; point lies within building and does not define affected extent.
sources.origin: Historic England and MHCLG via Planning Data
sources.guard: Point is not exact listing extent, curtilage, condition or listed-building-consent outcome.

sources.title: Listed building outline
sources.facts: 124,897 outlines; 96 providers; collector and new data 2026-07-24; work in progress and incomplete nationally.
sources.guard: Outline is indicative, does not consistently show curtilage and requires further checks before decisions.

sources.title: Conservation area
sources.facts: 11,007 areas; 158 providers; collector and new data 2026-07-27; incomplete with duplicates and mixed sources.
sources.origin: LPAs, Historic England, data.gov.uk and MHCLG
sources.guard: Incomplete/duplicate geometry cannot independently establish current designation extent or permission outcome.

sources.title: Scheduled monument
sources.facts: 20,150 monuments; 1 provider; collector 2026-07-27; new data 2026-07-25; Historic England-maintained list.
sources.guard: Designation record does not replace the definitive schedule, current condition or scheduled-monument consent.

sources.title: World heritage site
sources.facts: 40 sites; 2 providers; collector 2026-07-24; new data 2026-07-11; UNESCO designation adds no additional statutory controls by itself.
sources.origin: UNESCO/Historic England and MHCLG via Planning Data
sources.guard: WHS designation is not an independent statutory planning control or permission refusal.

sources.title: World heritage site buffer zone
sources.facts: 9 buffer zones; 1 provider; collector 2026-07-26; new data 2026-06-30; mixed MHCLG origin with Historic England attribution.
sources.origin: Historic England and MHCLG via Planning Data
sources.guard: Buffer implications require plan/policy review; boundary is not automatic statutory control or decision.

sources.title: Locally listed building
sources.facts: Experimental dataset sourced from data.gov.uk while specifications are developed with a group of LPAs.
sources.origin: Local sources and MHCLG design work
sources.guard: Local listing is not national designation and dataset coverage is not complete or uniformly authoritative.

sources.title: Listed building data specification
sources.facts: Last updated 2025-08-07; requires at least one row per listed building and polygon/multipolygon geometry in WGS84 where possible.
sources.guard: Specification conformity improves structure but does not itself validate legal curtilage, currency or consent.
